credits.overview: Two Mexican officers must survive the final hours of their shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss.

credits.title: Under the Same Moon
credits.overview: Tells the parallel stories of nine-year-old Carlitos and his mother, Rosario. In the hopes of providing a better life for her son, Rosario works illegally in the U.S. while her mother cares for Carlitos back in Mexico.
